metadata.method: Original locator screenshot, temporary foreground-only transparency/visibility probe, exact inline-style restoration and conservative sRGB minimum over text-layout rectangles expanded1pixel. No average ratios. SVG uses a full-page probe with recorded document coordinates.
limitations: Not Stark and not a complete WCAG audit.
A minimum over the entire bounding box is conservative: failing this bound does not establish a failure at glyph pixels.
No antialiasing text pixels are used to estimate the foreground. CSS computed ink is composited over each rendered background pixel.
Ancestor opacity below1 or text clipping/overlap prevents an unqualified pass.
No participant, screen-reader or native zoom claim.
metadata.interpretation: Manual review required is inconclusive, not a WCAG failure. Twelve current samples cannot establish a conservative pass: two login restorations exceed the recorded RGB tolerance and ten SVG text-layout rectangles retain foreground/overlap pixels. Do not infer global contrast conformance from the31passing samples.

nodes.html: CONTIGO

contrast.method: For every unique rendered background pixel in text-layout rectangles expanded1pixel, composite computed CSS foreground RGBA and calculate WCAG sRGB luminance ratio; report minimum, not average. SVG text uses visibility:hidden and a full-page background probe cropped to the recorded document coordinates. If restored pixels differ by at most2RGB levels, conservatively vary background channels by the observed maximum difference.
conditions: Restoration is not verified within maximum2RGB-level rendering tolerance.
